namedQueries.name: streets
namedQueries.query: PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/streets#> SELECT ?street ?id ?category ?length ?width ?oneWay WHERE { ?street a ex:Street ; ex:id ?id ; ex:category ?category ; ex:length ?length ; ex:width ?width ; ex:oneWay ?oneWay }

namedQueries.name: streetGeometries
namedQueries.query: PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/streets#> PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#> SELECT ?street ?wkt WHERE { ?street a ex:Street ; geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?wkt }

namedQueries.name: districts
namedQueries.query: PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/streets#> PREFIX geo: <http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#> SELECT ?district ?category ?population ?wkt WHERE { ?district a ex:District ; ex:category ?category ; ex:population ?population ; geo:hasGeometry/geo:asWKT ?wkt }

namedQueries.name: speedLimits
namedQueries.query: PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/streets#> SELECT ?street ?limit ?start ?end ?minSpeed ?maxSpeed WHERE { ?street ex:hasSpeedLimit ?limit . ?limit ex:start ?start ; ex:end ?end ; ex:minSpeed ?minSpeed ; ex:maxSpeed ?maxSpeed }
